content.text: I've reviewed the compensation, engagement, and termination provisions. No redline is needed.

input.quote: During the term of this Agreement, Company agrees to compensate Contractor as set forth in each Statement of Work. Contractor will be compensated on a time and materials.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, guaranteed spend, guaranteed hours, take-or-pay, shortfall charge, exclusivity or volume restriction on Clear Capital. Engagement is expressly "on a task by task basis" under mutually agreed Statements of Work (p0004), and compensation is time-and-materials for Services actually performed plus actual expenses (p0013). Termination for convenience is available whenever no Statement of Work is outstanding on 15 days' notice, and on breach the Contractor is paid only for fees "incurred or earned ... through the effective date of such termination" (p0032, p0033) — i.e., no early-termination or shortfall penalty. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "take or pay", "shortfall", "guarantee", "volume" and "quota" returned no Customer-side commitment language. This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for ordered services only), so no redline is proposed. Noted only for the record: Contractor may change rates on 30 days' notice (p0014) with no uplift cap, which is a pricing point addressed under the price-increase rule rather than this one.
